nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Configuration template defining 107 environment variables for the trading pipeline, covering application settings, trading credentials (Binance/Alpaca), external API keys, database/cache configuration, monitoring parameters, and scheduler intervals.
nodes.languageNotes: Environment configuration uses key=value pairs organized by functional groups with inline documentation for each variable's purpose and expected values.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Claude Code project instructions covering model economy strategies, hard rules for trading safety (TRADING_MODE guardrails), database/CLI quick facts, and knowledge graph usage via Graphify.

nodes.name: Makefile
nodes.summary: Build automation with 12 targets orchestrating Docker Compose operations: preflight validation, service lifecycle (up/down/restart), deployment verification, SQL schema checking, health monitoring, and test execution.
nodes.languageNotes: Makefile uses POSIX shell (bash) for service management and prefixes commands with explanatory echo statements for user feedback.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive project documentation describing the market intelligence pipeline architecture (6 engine layers), tech stack, setup guide for macOS/Linux/Windows (WSL), usage instructions, troubleshooting, and repository structure.

nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Multi-container orchestration configuration deploying 27 services including API, validation, Postgres, Redis, Prometheus, Discord bot, and specialized engines for news ingestion, sentiment analysis, smart money tracking, and signal validation.
nodes.languageNotes: YAML-based Docker Compose v2 with reusable anchors (x-common-env, x-restart, x-logging) for configuration consistency across 27 services.

nodes.name: requirements.txt
nodes.summary: Production Python dependencies including FastAPI/uvicorn (web framework), asyncpg/redis (persistence), aiohttp/httpx (networking), Discord.py (bot), OpenAI/Anthropic (AI), and market data clients (yfinance).

nodes.name: requirements-dev.txt
nodes.summary: Development testing dependencies with pytest as the unit test framework, intended to be installed alongside requirements.txt for local test execution without Docker.
